schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The BUILD skill: the stage after the preamble, fired as /sail <something>. Consumes the /chart chain's berths (template-fills from the deepest berthed stage; refuses to build from the conversation), requires a cast ticket (/sorted owns casting), and runs the voyage discipline as numbered skill-steps: journal BUILDME -> build inside the bounds (constrain = hard edges, survey holdings = compose, absences = build-minimal) -> prove twice -> PROVEME + tester seal -> live fire -> PROVED + records settled -> deposit learnings -> commit/push verified by instrument -> close the boundary with /saveslate then an invitation to /compact (a client command the skill cannot fire; making the boundary loud IS the step).
why: Akien, 2026-07-28, verbatim: 'we still need a build skill, whatever it shall be called... according to you in the web interface, we should simply add /compact to the end of /sorted and the new build skill' + 'i might suggest we also have a /saveslate before the compact'. The deep why is the ratified pattern from the daemons correction: CC-discipline moves into skill-STEPS, not personal habit (Law 4) — the whole build liturgy (chokepoint crossings, prove-twice, seal, live fire, deposit-back, commit-is-done) has lived in CC's habit and memory files, varying with the session; behind the slash-door it fires the same way every time. The /saveslate-then-/compact close makes the compaction boundary SAFE by construction: the slate is the durable half, so the context being dropped is provably scaffolding. NAMING: /sail is CC's coinage, flagged as such (terms-drift discipline) — you chart a course, then you sail it; sits beside chart/charter/voyage/berth/harbor in the ship vocabulary, and the record already calls the BUILDME->PROVED journey a VOYAGE, which /sail runs. RATIFIED 2026-07-28, Akien: 'sail. i like that.' — the name is settled.
invoke: /sail <request> (symlinked ~/.claude/skills/sail -> repo skills/sail). Requires: berthed /chart packets for the request + a cast ticket.
node_class: skill — prose-as-implementation in class-space; the standing host-seam pattern (repo skills/ + symlink) carries it; hangs the cairnmap recompile gate like every skill node.
entry: FRESH, 2026-07-28, cast the same day /chart reached three stages — the chain finally emits enough settled input for the build stage to template-fill from.
state_and_history: voyage journaled on the chart device (the chain it completes); this charter stays pure intention+why.
how_it_learns: Through the bricks it composes, not privately: every /sail crossing deposits its berths back (step 7), corrections ride orient's brick loop, and build failures seed inspector filters by installation. The skill's own prose sharpens by /challenge like every skill; a recurring deviation between the steps and what CC actually does is the signal the prose is wrong or the discipline needs physics (the gate ladder: prose -> skill-step -> chokepoint).
filed_edges: (a) the middle stages (decompose/triage/hypothesize/validate) land between /chart and /sail as bricks; /sail then fills from a deeper chain without changing shape
(b) a /sail proof (skills/sail/proofs/) pinning the refusal contract — no berths / no ticket — once the skill has enough crossings to know its real failure modes
(c) the /saveslate-then-/compact close is also /sorted's close (same ruling, same act) — if a third skill wants it, the close becomes a shared fragment, earned not merged
gates: the /challenge cadence (skill prose); the recompile gate on charter writes; the REAL gate is downstream — every step it names is already enforced by physics where physics exists (chokepoint build gate, tester seal, berth doors), so the skill mostly cannot lie about having run them.
falsifier: RED on any of: a /sail build that filled from the conversation while berths existed; a bound from the constrain berth silently widened; a holding rebuilt in parallel; 'done' reported without the instrument's verification; the close skipped (no slate before a compact at a build boundary). WRONG-SHAPE SIGNAL: if /sail crossings routinely skip steps without a red anywhere, the discipline needs to move down the ladder from skill-step to physics.

counted_by.what_it_counts: NOTHING. /sail is the one skill in the roster that leaves no firing record anywhere. Measured 2026-08-04, after checking every store the other ten are counted in: no berth, no packet, no trace, no conforming commons record, no tree node.
counted_by.why_this_is_the_worst_place_for_it: /sail is the BUILD step — the most expensive firing in the workflow and the only one that consumes a whole /chart chain. Its charter says its voyage is 'journaled on the chart device (the chain it completes)', which is true of the chain and false of the firing: a /sail that reads berths and then builds nothing leaves the chain looking identical to a /sail that shipped. The step whose failure costs the most is the step we cannot see fail.
counted_by.why_not_fixed_here: unlike the other five, this one cannot be closed by declaring where the count already lives, because it does not live anywhere — it needs something built. That is a ticket, not a charter field, and inventing a number for it would be exactly the hollow the rest of this work removed. It stays a dash, loudly.
counted_by.the_cheapest_candidate: /sail already refuses without berths and a cast ticket; that refusal is a judgement being made and thrown away. Berthing the firing — forward AND refused — would cost one write at a gate that already runs, which is what makes a citation cheap (WorkflowDefinition §1). Not built, and not built quietly: this is the dash the roster prints.

proof: PROVED 2026-07-28 by the first real crossing: the voyage that delivered decompose (tickets decompose-filters + chart-decompose) ran every step end to end — charted from berths (never the conversation), built inside the bounds, proved twice, sealed, live-fired, records settled, learnings deposited, commit instrument-verified, closed with slate + invitation. The constituent physics (chokepoint, tester, doors) stands proven where it lives; edge (b)'s refusal-contract proof still waits for enough crossings to know the real failure modes. Found in the crossing: the chokepoint refuses skill@v1 voyages (no registered workflow for class skill) — filed as ticket edge (d), RETIRED 2026-07-29 (ticket skills-ride-the-chokepoint): class skill@v1 is now registered at CairnCommons/node_classes/skill.json (the six summonses mirroring code-seam@v1's path verbatim, TICKETME skippable), zero changes to cairn/base/transitions.py — the registry was the whole door. /sail's own record was then born by its first real journaled crossing (the live fire this stone owed): skills/sail/history.json + state.json, THINKME -> BUILDME, naming this same ticket, the entry gate clean over a berthed chart chain. The record starts mid-life — /sail proved out in prose a day before its record could exist — and every /sail crossing from here rides the chokepoint like any code-seam's.
owner: CC owns the prose + the symlink and gates writes. Akien owns the design ruling (build skill + /compact close + /saveslate before it, 2026-07-28) and the NAME — /sail ratified 2026-07-28 ('sail. i like that.').
provenance: Born 2026-07-28, mid-session, on Akien's word during the chart-survey build — the same day the chain grew to three stages and both stackable learning bricks carried their first real learnings.
